structured.answer: I didn't choose anything. The page is endless rows of percentages with no sentence saying which track is safe, so I'll ask my son or the bank. The "מבטיח תשואה" tracks sounded like a deposit, but they say "לא דווח".

stuck.why: "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026" made me doubt every number below it
They sound safe like a deposit, but the fee and return say "לא דווח" / "עוד לא דווח", so I couldn't judge them
Row after row of the same kind of numbers and nothing saying which is safe; I got tired and stopped

used: Company group names (מיטב, מור, הפניקס, אלטשולר שחם)
skipped: Tabs at the top (מדריך, חוקים וכללים, השוואה למטרה, השקעה במדד)
unsure_meaning: מניות / מט"ח percentages, and values above 100% such as 101%, 103%
בניהול אישי: כל חוסך מחליט במה להשקיע
Small numbers with an arrow icon such as 1486, 13246
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is safe, like a deposit
A comparison with a bank deposit
A clear explanation of how much the fees cost in shekels

findings.what: Very long, dense table of percentages with no plain-language summary of which tracks are low-risk
Warning that the data has not been updated, placed at the very top, undermines trust
Tracks that "promise a return" show "לא דווח" for fees and returns, exactly where a cautious saver would look
findings.where: Screen 1 rows ביטוח מבטיח תשואה; screen 3 גמולה מבטיחת תשואה

findings.what: Grey small text on a dark background ("3 שנים", "ההחיסכון", "ההפקדה") is hard to read
Two close colours in the small ring charts can't be told apart and aren't explained
English terms like S&P500 in filters and track names
A 2% fee is shown without any warning that it is high
